# GitHub Copilot Engineering Standards

## Project Rules & Blueprints

CRITICAL: Before writing code or proposing architectural changes, you MUST read
the blueprint and planning documents located in the `${LTAT_TOP_LEVEL}/docs` directory. 

Always look for a corresponding file in `${LTAT_TOP_LEVEL}/docs` that matches
the scope of the feature you are working on (e.g.,
${LTAT_TOP_LEVEL}/docs/auth-flow.md for login features) and prioritize its
rules over generic assumptions.
